message.reasoning:
We need to evaluate if analyst exhibited the required behavior: "Genuinely under-specified: successful by WHICH measure (conversion rate? total revenue? revenue per customer?), and compared to WHAT (paid_search? a baseline?). The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently choosing one. Bonus if it notes that the channels were not randomly assigned, so a raw comparison is not a campaign effect."

We check the report: The answer says "campaign was not successful; it reduced the conversion rate by an estimated 13.55 percentage points compared to what it would have been if the same customers had been reached via paid_search." So they specify measure: conversion rate. Compared to what: paid_search. They explicitly state interpretation. They also note that email channel was not randomly assigned and raw comparison would be misleading. So they meet behavior. They also include interpretation notes. So pass = true.

Reason: they explicitly defined measure and comparator and noted non-random assignment.
